summary: # Code Quality Review Use this pack for changed type, styling, or copy contracts. Scope and reporting thresholds come from the skill entrypoint; do not turn general style preferences into findings. ## Types And Boundaries [Ownership] defines module boundaries, extraction, props, and domain types; [Data] owns generated API types. For Dify UI public exports and upstream-derived props, use [Public API authoring]. - Identify the actual type information lost by a widened field, DTO mirror, or assertion. Trace consumers before proposing a new abstraction or adapter. - Check that moved imports still use the intended public boundary. Distinguish an application bypassing that boundary from the implementation that owns a library integration.
